name: mcp-workspace
description: Notion, Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) and Slack MCP servers.

notion_token.title: Notion integration token
notion_token.description: Create an internal integration at notion.so/profile/integrations and share pages with it. Leave empty if unused.

google_oauth_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_oauth_client_id.description: Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials > OAuth client ID (Desktop app). Leave empty if unused.

slack_token.title: Slack user token (xoxp-)
slack_token.description: Create a Slack app, add user scopes, install it, copy the User OAuth Token. Leave empty if unused.
